messages:
Sofia (support): FYI customer reported token counts in SDK estimator ~= 540 but API usage shows total_tokens: 720. They think completions are double-counted? Asking for help to triage.
Alex (customer): Repro steps attached. We send a chat completion with system + user + a tool message. SDK local counter shows 540, API response usage shows 720. Invoice reflects API usage.
Sofia (support): Can you paste the exact request you sent (headers + body minus key) and the API response usage block? Also the SDK version you used.
Alex (customer): Sure — request body: 
```json
{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are terse."},{"role":"tool","name":"price_checker","content":"lookup sku 123"},{"role":"user","content":"What's the price?"}],"max_tokens":150,"stream":false}
```
API response usage snippet: 
```json
"usage": {"prompt_tokens":430, "completion_tokens":290, "total_tokens":720}
```
SDK estimator output (node SDK 0.12.3): totalTokensEstimate = 540 (prompt 400 + completion 140).
Devon (eng): Interesting — first-pass guesses: 1) tokenizer differences (model tokenizer vs SDK tokenizer) 2) system/tool role handling (SDK might be skipping tool messages) 3) hidden special tokens or message framing (role tags).
Priya (eng-ml): Also check whether API counts additional tokens for tool name/metadata when you pass a tool message. Some runtime framing inserts extra tokens for routing/metadata that SDK estimator may not replicate.
Marcus (billing): From billing side invoice numbers match API usage. We need repro to determine whether to adjust invoice or provide credit; usually billing follows service usage reported by the API.
Jamie (devex): Quick check — which tokenizer lib does the SDK estimator use? If it's a JS port of tiktoken vs runtime BPE difference could explain ~25-40% delta. SDK change log shows we switched tokenizer backend in 0.13.0 but user on 0.12.3.
Alex (customer): We're on sdk-js 0.12.3. I can try upgrading. Also note we include the tool message as role:tool with name; SDK estimator took the message content only.
Sofia (support): Can you try toggling stream:true and see if counts change? And please include request_id from the API response header (x-request-id) so eng can fetch full server-side logs.
Alex (customer): Updated test with stream:true shows API usage: prompt_tokens 440 completion_tokens 280 total 720. SDK estimator still 540. request-id: rq_01G8X8Z3Y2.
Devon (eng): Thanks — grabbing logs. Preliminary: server log shows additional 180 prompt-side tokens attributed to tool metadata and system framing. Example snippet: 
```
[server] framing tokens added: "<|system|>" "<|tool:name:price_checker|>" ...
```
That matches the 180 gap.
Priya (eng-ml): Those framing tokens are added by the runtime for the chat format when sending to the model; our SDK estimator earlier intentionally skipped tool-name tokens to approximate user-visible content. That creates a consistent delta when customers include tool messages.
Jamie (devex): Noted. SDK should surface a warning when conversation includes tool messages or system role with meta fields. We should add a note in docs and a patch to estimator.
Marcus (billing): For this customer, do we issue an adjustment? Policy: billing follows model usage; if delta caused by SDK estimator bug, that's on SDK. If customer relied on SDK for quota alerts we may offer a one-time credit. Suggest support propose a credit while Engineering releases a fix.
Sofia (support): Proposed reply to customer: explain that API usage is authoritative; engineering found runtime inserts tool framing tokens not counted by their older SDK estimator; offer one-time credit for unexpected overage and coordinate SDK fix + doc note. Agree? :thumbsup:
Alex (customer): Thanks, that sounds fair. Also can you share a temp script to replicate server-side tokenization so we can run prior to deploy?
Devon (eng): I'll paste a small repro script (python) that uses the same tokenizer and shows framing tokens counted: 
```py
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
msg = [{"role":"system","content":"You are terse."},{"role":"tool","name":"price_checker","content":"lookup sku 123"},{"role":"user","content":"What's the price?"}]
frame = '[SYSTEM]'+msg[0]["content"]+'[TOOL:'+msg[1]["name"]+']'+msg[1]["content"]+msg[2]["content"]
print(Tokenizer.encode(frame))
```
Devon (eng): We'll also open a tiny internal ticket to update SDK estimator behaviour and docs.
Jamie (devex): I'll draft a docs blurb on "Why SDK token counts may differ from API usage" covering tokenizer backends, tool/system framing, and streaming vs non-streaming.
Marcus (billing): Once support confirms customer acceptance, I can apply a one-time credit and mark invoice note.
Sofia (support): I'll send the customer the write-up + credit offer and keep this thread updated. Closing loop once SDK release and docs published. :white_check_mark:
